似.meaning: A puppy copies everything its owner does. The owner hangs his scarf on the <part>coat hook</part>, so the puppy hangs its lead there too, <part>because</part> that's what he does. Day by day the puppy is <kanji>becoming</kanji> just like him, glasses and all.
似.on: They even drive the same muddy <sound>jee</sound>p, the puppy in a tiny one behind.
似.kun: When the owner scratches his k<sound>nee</sound>, the puppy scratches its knee too.

争.meaning: Two gardeners both want the last sunflower seed in the shed. One snatches a <part>boomerang</part>, the other a <part>rake</part> and a <part>crowbar</part>, and they circle each other over the tiny seed. Neither will give in. They <kanji>contend</kanji> till sunset.
争.on: In the end both slip on a bar of <sound>soa</sound>p left on the shed floor.
争.kun: '<sound>Ah</sound>!' '<sound>Rah</sound>!' they yell, and tumble onto an old <sound>so</sound>fa, still wrestling.

呼.meaning: A lonely fisherman has no bait, so he ties a big painted <part>mouth</part> to the end of his <part>fishing rod</part> and dangles it over the lake. Each time he jiggles the line, the mouth shouts 'Dinner!' and fish come swimming. That's his way to <kanji>call</kanji> them.
呼.on: A <sound>ko</sound>ala in the tree above hears it too and drops into his boat, hungry.
呼.kun: '<sound>Yo</sound>!' he shouts to his pal, a <sound>bu</sound>ll grazing on the shore. 'Come and see!'

玄.meaning: On a dusty shelf sits a jar with a tight <part>lid</part>. Inside, something dark and smoky curls into a slow <part>twist</part>, though nothing ever touches it. Nobody remembers who put it there or what it is. It's utterly <kanji>mysterious</kanji>.
玄.on: The jar stands by the bi<sound>g</sound> <sound>en</sound>trance door, and every guest who passes it shivers.
玄.kun: At midnight a <sound>cu</sound>ckoo pecks the lid, and a black <sound>ro</sound>dent scurries out.

率.meaning: A snowman tailor sews his coats by one strict rule: for every <part>spool</part> of thread, exactly <part>ten</part> buttons made of <part>ice</part>. One button more and the coat sinks; one fewer and it flaps open. Everything depends on the <kanji>ratio</kanji>.
率.on: He counts out the buttons on <sound>Ritz</sound> crackers, one button per cracker.
率.kun: In his best <sound>hee</sound>ls, he leads a parade of <sound>ki</sound>wi birds in ice-button coats down the street.

隊.meaning: A <part>pig</part> with plastic <part>horns</part> on its helmet marches out in front, waving a <part>pennant</part>. Behind it come four hundred more pigs, all in step, all horned, all grunting the same march. It's the farm's proudest <kanji>regiment</kanji>.
隊.on: Every soldier pig wears a smart striped <sound>tie</sound> under its chin.

将.meaning: Clinging to the top of a <part>climbing pole</part> by one <part>claw</part>, a cat swings a <part>golf club</part> at the crows circling below and yells orders to the kittens. Every kitten copies her swing. She's clearly their <kanji>leader</kanji>.
将.on: Each evening the kittens put on a <sound>show</sound> in her honour, golf clubs and all.
将.kun: '<sound>Ma</sound>!' they cry, and she tosses each kitten a <sound>sa</sound>rdine: exactly one each.
